name: std::iscntrl(std::locale)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT>

bool iscntrl(CharT ch, const locale &loc);

intro: Checks if the given character is classified as a control character by the given locale's std::ctype facet.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns true if the character is classified as a control character, false otherwise.

sections.title: Possible implementation

examples.output:
iscntrl(CCH, C locale) returned false
iscntrl(CCH, Unicode locale) returned true

summary: Checks if the given character is classified as a control character by the given locale's std::ctype facet.
